Alex R.: Pager tuning notes: the alert threshold for svc_inference_api.errors should not page at 1% transient spikes. Proposal: only page if errors >= 3% sustained for 10m OR if error burn rate crosses 5% in 5m AND p95 latency > 1.5s. Also add a suppression window for autoscaler-driven flux.
